entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Luhansk State Medical University or LSMU is a higher education institution, established in 1956 in Luhansk, a city in the Russian-occupied Luhansk Oblast of Ukraine. Due to the War in Donbas, the LSMU temporarily moved from Luhansk to Rubizhne in October 2014. Since March 2022, the LSMU has temporarily moved to the city of Rivne, capital of Rivne Oblast in northwestern Ukraine.
